saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 7ης Οκτωβρίου — «Άγιος Πολυχρόνιος ο Ιερομάρτυρας»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 7 Οκτωβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day the folder already keeps. saint.gr calls him «ο Ιερομάρτυρας» and makes him a presbyter of Constantinople killed by Arians at the altar under the emperor Constantius; the corpus's `types` for him are `martyr` and `presbyter`, and the hieromartyr rank the page gives is left for the writer to decide rather than added here. The page states the fourth century, so a `dates` object is proposed from its own words. It prints no hymn for him. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence on the life page. A second entry on the same day, «Άγιοι Δέκα συναθλητές του Αγίου Πολυχρονίου», names his ten fellow contenders, who are drafted as ten new folders in batch el-10-07-1.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue as printed by pravoslavno.rs (24 September 2026).
